avicāravaśānmūḍho loko'yaṃ pariroditi iti yaduktaṃ tadādau prapañcayati -
līlayetyādinā

pralayasuṣuptyorajñānāvṛtatvānniratiśayānandarūpatvātparamapremāspadaṃ
svasvarūpamapaśyati ātmani kāmakarmavāsanāparipākakramaprāptena
sargajāgarādikālena līlayā cidvilāsenaiva vapuḥ
sūkṣmasthūlasamaṣṭivyaṣṭiśarīraṃ jāyate

yathā ramyasya
kāntāputrādervakramapaśyato virahipuruṣasya hṛdi
mlānikārśyādidaurūpyāpādikā daurmanasyadhīrnirantaraṃ jāyate tadvadityarthaḥ

tasya dehadvayasya vaśāttadahaṃbhāvādhyāsena tadvaśatāprāpteriyaṃ
niratiśayānartharūpā māyā mithyābhūtaiva rāgalobhamohādirmadasya
mahāśaktirāyātā

anarthaprāptiprakāramuktvā taducchedopāyaṃ vaktuṃ
prathamamarthacetanāccittaṃ
tanmananānmanastadadhyavasāyādbuddhistadabhimānādahaṃkāra iti
ekamevāntaḥkaraṇamaṅkurakāṇḍamūlaprarohaśākhādiprarohakrameṇa vṛks'
iva sarvataḥ prasṛtamavatiṣṭhata ityāha - citteti dvābhyām

manasi mananotke sati tadeva vapuḥ
śarīrākāraṃ bhavati tacca punarbahirmukhatāpādanāddoṣāyetyarthaḥ

paricchinnavapurbhāva evāsya doṣo na śuddhātmabhāvo jagadātmabhāvo
vetyāśayenāha - ātmanīti

nanvastu śuddhātmabhāve evaṃ sarvātmabhāve tu
śākhācalanādvṛkṣasyevātmanaścalanaṃ durvāramiti cettatrāha -
pratibimbiteti

tathāca caladanekapratibimbātmabhāvāpannāpi sphaṭikaśilā yathā
kūṭasthā tathā ātmāpīti bhāvaḥ
tatraivamatyantavaidharmye sati ayaṃ dehaḥ sa prasiddho'ham

idaṃ bāhyaṃ
strīputrādi ca mama iti mohaḥ

yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasaṃjñāḥ iti
dhyāyatyartha prati duraḥ agatitvāt gaikāraketarapūrvapadasya yaṇ neṣyate
ityukterna yaṇ

evamatyantavaidharmye'pi dehe jñatvādaya ātmani kartṛtvādayaśca
viruddhadharmā avidyākallolarāgādyupahatayā
dehāditādātmyasaṃsargādhyāsaprayuktatvādanityayā
bhrāntidṛśaivopalabhyanta ityarthaḥ

udayaṃ punaḥ svarūpāvirbhāvaṃ ca naiti
sakṛdvibhātatvādityarthaḥ
rāmaṃ prati tallakṣaṇāni śikṣayati - sarvaiṣaṇā ityādinā

niravaśeṣeṇa
niḥśeṣatayā dhārāḥ jalāni tyaktvā payodharo yathā bhavati tathetyarthaḥ
he rāma te tava āśā na santi

ato
vairāgyādisādhanasaṃpattyā mukhyādhikāritvāttattvajñānasaṃpattyā jagat vahati
dhāvati rathe sthitasya puṃsa ubhayapārśvadiśorbhrāntyā
tarugulmādeścakrākāraparāvartavanmithyābhramamātraṃ viddhityarthaḥ

jagattu mithayabhramaṃ vahati rathe
sthitayoścakrayorūrdhvādhodikṣu parāvarto yadvannemyavalambipipīlikādeḥ
patanapeṣaṇādyanarthahetustadvatsvāvalambināṃ
jananamaraṇādyanarthārthamevotthitaṃ viddhityarthaḥ

utkṛṣṭāśānāṃ nikṛṣṭāstenatvaṃ abhipretya nairāśyaṃ
mayoktamiti na viddhi

yato
vahadrathasthasya dikcakreṣu paryāyeṇa parāvarto bhramaṇaṃ vahadrathavegena
diṅmoho vā tadvadutthitaṃ tadityarthaḥ
vit ātmavettā kiṃcidapi nāśāste na vāñchati

nāśāsyaṃ puruṣārtharūpaṃ jagatyasti atastvaṃ
āśānāṃ saṃbandhī na bhavetyarthaḥ

ātyantikanairāśyopāyamanviṣya tadadarśanānmuhyamānamiva rāmamupalakṣya
dehādāvahaṃmamatātyāga eva prāguktastadupāya ityāgraheṇa smārayannāha pūrvottarakālaprasiddhaḥ ayaṃ vartamānakāle pratyakṣa ahameveti kiṃ
muhyasītyarthaḥ
kīdṛśaṃ tarhi sarvapadārthānāṃ yathārtharūpaṃ tadāha - bhāveti
evaṃ kāmādidoṣā api palāyanta ityāśayenāha - kāntāmiti

gṛhasthasya tattvavidaḥ svalalanādibhogāsvāde'pi na
kaścidrāgivadatiśayabhramo'stītyāha - kāketi

vyagreṇa tattatkālocitakriyāvyāpṛtenāpi dehendriyādinā samanvito jñastattvavit
gatavyagro nirvikṣepa eva tiṣṭhati

antardoṣasaṅgasyaiva dūṣakatvaṃ na bahiḥsaṅgasyetyatra dṛṣṭāntamāha -
kalaṅkīti

hema antaḥkalaṅkenaiva kalaṅki ucyate anyathā bahiḥ paṅkādilepena
tathā nocyate tadvadityarthaḥ

vṛkṣasthavṛntāccyutaṃ phalaṃ punarvṛnte kena samarthenāpi mahatāpi
prayatnena pūrvavadvaddham

yathā pāṣāṇāntargataṃ maṇiṃ pāṣāṇacchedanena maṇitattvavicāreṇa ca
abhitaḥ amaṇyaṃśakhaṇḍanato gataṃ prāptaṃ punaḥ pūrvavattaṃ pāṣāṇaṃ
maṇiṃ ca saṃdhātuṃ kasyābhāgyasya śaktatāstītyarthaḥ

te sarve nānāpuṣparasā
madhubhāva iva yatra samarasā bhavanti tādṛśasvātmānandacidālokasya
avalambanaṃ nirantarāsvādadhārāṃ prāptā tattvajñasya buddhiḥ kena
vismārayituṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ

tathācoktaṃ śivadharmottare -
jñānāmṛtaraso yena sakṛdāsvādito bhavet

vyavahāraṃ gṛhakarma akhaṇḍitaṃ sadā kurvan bhartrā śvaśurābhyāṃ ca
kheditaḥ pīḍito'pi paravyasanavānvadhūloka iti pareṇānvayaḥ

acitto manonāśaparyantabhūmikāpratiṣṭhitaḥ puruṣadhaureyo vidhinā
prāktanaprārabdhaphalena karmaṇā vidhureṣu bhogaśūnyeṣu dāridryādiṣu
māṇḍavyavacchūlādhirohaṇādisaṃkaṭeṣu vā purottame sadane vā vitatagirau
vipine tapovane vā nivasatu tathāpi sadā vyapagatasukhaduḥkhasaṃnipāta evāste na
manāgapi sāṃsarikairharṣaśokaiḥ spṛśyata ityarthaḥ
